cards.anchor: Explain short returns sufficiently to choose a bounded change, targeting five complete twelve-counter kits in the serviceable circulating pool and reconciliation within five minutes. Five simultaneously ready shelf kits is a separate, unresolved interpretation; this construction cannot promise it during active loans.
cards.construction: Origin-gated self-service reconciliation hypothesis: keep numbered trays and self-service return, but direct every counter belonging to a selected intervention return into its own tray. After independently checking checkout, watch that return continuously from placement through its available observation window. Record the two separate first counts before any supplementation, then borrower arrivals, searches, and volunteer transfers in seconds. Unattributed mat counters remain separately accounted. A later reserve transfer may restore serviceability, but the tally labels it replenishment rather than completed borrower return.
cards.mutation: Replace P2's inference from a contemporaneous mat counter with a distinction between witnessed borrower completion, witnessed replenishment, and unresolved origin. Compare one prospectively selected ordinary return with one direct-to-own-tray return, sequentially within the same block.
cards.rival: H2: traffic or volunteer handling supplies another loan's counter. H3 counting error remains an alternative; changed attention can also alter behavior.
cards.probe: Before the block, separately verify five candidate twelve-counter kits and account for the eleven remaining counters. Predeclare intended demand and eligibility and record deviations. For selected returns, one volunteer watches transfers while the other counts; obtain separate counts before movement and at placement plus one, three, and five minutes when feasible. Log mat counts, waiting borrowers, active loans, and remaining time. Never interrupt a loan or shorten five-minute use; inspect only one tray at a time.
cards.prediction_candidate: If delayed borrower completion operates, a directly watched counter from that borrower should arrive after tray placement and before search or volunteer supplementation; agreed counts should then rise from eleven to twelve. Direct-to-own-tray routing should place that arrival in the matching tray. This supports H1 only for the witnessed event.
cards.prediction_rival: If cross-loan redistribution produces recovery, a witnessed other-loan or volunteer movement should precede the increase, without a corresponding borrower arrival. Count disagreements or twelve found without a transfer support counting uncertainty. An unwatched mat arrival selects neither H1 nor H2.
cards.defeat: A witnessed other-source recovery defeats the borrower-completion account for that event. A shortage unresolved at five minutes fails reconciliation. Ending observation earlier or seeing no anomaly leaves mechanism discrimination incomplete. Unlogged replenishment or attribution by proximity defeats the evidential construction.
cards.burden: Two volunteers share at most twenty minutes each. Selected returns must occur early enough for feasible follow-up; missed transfers and checkpoints are recorded. Reserve use can consume the eleven-counter remainder and does not establish ownership. No camera, additional block, spare purchase, or permanent marking is required.
unknowns: Historical loose-counter origins, shared count errors, and unresolved counter location remain unknown.
Demand, compliance, attention effects, and ability to maintain five serviceable kits after a new shortage are untested.
The intended meaning of available kits requires clarification before claiming the whole outcome.

cards.anchor: Choose a bounded return procedure using evidence of counter origin while targeting five serviceable complete kits and five-minute reconciliation. Treat availability during active loans and feasibility of the complete outcome as unresolved.
cards.construction: Report-gated recovery hypothesis, an alternative single-block protocol: prospectively choose two ordinary self-service returns sequentially. After separately recording first counts before movement, preassign immediate shortage announcement for one return and announcement at sixty seconds for the other. During the delayed interval, the counting volunteer makes no shortage-triggered search or transfer; the other watches borrower arrivals and unrelated handling. After announcement, log search and every transfer before replenishment. Keep a twelve-counter tray eligible as soon as checked; never issue eleven.
cards.mutation: Change when a shortage report can initiate P2's corrective search, while retaining open trays, the shared mat, full loan allowance, and predeclared demand. This tests the reversed arrow in which reporting creates apparent recovery.
cards.rival: Forward H1: the borrower independently completes a delayed return. Background H2 redistribution, counting uncertainty, demand, and additional attention can produce overlapping timing patterns.
cards.probe: Record placement, separate counts, announcement, borrower counter arrival, search, transfer, and later counts with the stopwatch and tally. Watch one selected return at a time and keep the area usable. Record active loans and waiting borrowers. Require sufficient block time for the sixty-second gate and the remaining five-minute reconciliation window; otherwise record incomplete follow-up. Verify the five initial kits and separately account for eleven remaining counters.
cards.prediction_candidate: If the shortage report triggers corrective recovery, search and witnessed volunteer supplementation should occur after announcement, with the delayed arm shifting these events correspondingly. An increase after that transfer is replenishment, not proof of borrower return. Two events provide a discriminating candidate observation, not an established causal effect.
cards.prediction_rival: If independent delayed borrower completion operates, watched borrower-origin arrivals can precede announcement and search, with agreed recovery following that arrival. A recovery from unrelated handling before announcement fits background redistribution. Count disagreement without movement fits counting uncertainty.
cards.defeat: Borrower-origin recovery before any announcement or search defeats shortage-triggered recovery for that event. No short return, missed origins, or unmatched demand leaves comparison inconclusive. Any unresolved shortage at five minutes fails reconciliation; restoration by reserve transfer cannot be reported as borrower completion.
cards.burden: The sixty-second pause consumes part of the five-minute deadline and may delay kit availability. Two volunteers and one twenty-minute block bound attention and sample size. This protocol and the first card are alternatives, not a request for two blocks. All ordinary traffic and deviations must be logged rather than presumed equal.
unknowns: Report suppression may change attention or behavior beyond search timing.
Two selected returns may offer no anomalies or insufficiently comparable circumstances.
Original origins, count accuracy, closing-time causes, and the availability interpretation remain unresolved.
